en: Black-and-white postcard image showing a grand Neo‑Romanesque terrace complex with sweeping staircases, arched colonnades, circular decorative windows and two prominent conical towers. The structure is built of light stone on a hillside, with ornate balustrades, lampposts and multiple levels of walkways, viewed from below. A large arched entrance and broad staircases dominate the foreground; the long arcade and turrets run along the top of the rampart.
